cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your shelf fell because they supplied the wrong bracket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You fitted it upside down. Look at the arrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. That's a misleading arrow. We should photograph it for the manufacturer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You drew that arrow. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because theirs was missing. Put that in the complaint; they made us supply our own safety markings.

mechanism: A treats its pupil correct identification of an assembly mistake as incomplete diagnosis, redirecting evidence of A error into manufacturer fault.
confusable: Not genuinely accepting correction from the pupil: A praises noticing while changing who the noticed fact incriminates.
comparison: Wet ink evidence versus A own orientation mark.
